scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/react build && bun run --cwd apps/playground build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/react typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/playground typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd packages/react test
scripts.test:all: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:coverage: bun run --cwd packages/core test:coverage && bun run --cwd packages/react test:coverage
